title: Spec availability per-user lookup for Principal; refresh isSubscribed doc
description: cfc3b31 (#451): getAvailability uses the Principal's own per-user isSubscribed/includeInAvailability, defaults if never set (rooms); isSubscribed defaults true for all calendars in the user's own account. Create default (calendar.rs:228) and chat seed calendar (chat-calendars-server lib.rs:166) already fit; comment calendar.rs:218-221 quotes old text; get_availability docs (backend.rs:1039-1046) silent on per-user lookup. Also check backend-created calendars default to true.
